title: HDPE grade transition A→B against the transition matrix: allowance, overrun, no standard
spec_ref: LA-08; SME Q9, Q10, E1, E3 (EXPERT_REVIEW §1.4)

inputs.standardAB: reference 2.1 h (7560 s) = median of illustrative A→B observations 1.8, 2.0, 2.1, 2.3, 2.8 h (SME E1)

notes: The transition loses the capacity of its running time (3 h x 30 t/h = 90 t): the off-grade it made (40 t, its own quality class) and the rate deficit (50 t). The standard allows 2.1 / 3 = 0.7 of each: 0.9 h of overrun = 27 t, the E1 worked example priced at the rate. With a reference off-grade quantity (30 t) the off-grade allowance is bounded in tonnes. Without a matrix entry nothing is invented: all 90 t are excess. All values are illustrative, not plant data.
